posts.post: We make our pieces on demand because I actually hate seeing our waste in a landfill. It is a flex to wear something made just for you instead of a mass produced rag. Does anyone else feel this shift?
Skinny jeans were never the problem, the way people styled them was. Stop letting micro-trends tell you what flatters your body. Can we bring back wearing what actually fits?
Looking pretty is easy, but having diva energy takes actual taste. It is about the intention behind the fabric, not the logo on the tag. Who agrees that quality is the only status symbol left?
